unit.title: Getting around
canDo: Say how far and how long

example.en: How are you getting to the airport?

example.py: Míngtiān wǒ zuò fēijī huí jiā.

example.en: I'm taking the train to Beijing.

example.py: Cóng zhèr dào jīchǎng yuǎn ma?
example.en: Is it far from here to the airport?

example.py: Dào le gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà!
example.en: Call me when you get there!

grammar.explanation: The way you travel comes before 去 and the place: 坐地铁去机场 (sit metro go airport). Driving and walking are verbs on their own: 开车去, 走路去. Ask with 怎么去？

examples.en: I take the metro to the airport.

grammar.pattern: 从 A 到 B + (要) + time
grammar.purpose: Say how far or how long a trip is
grammar.explanation: 从 A 到 B frames the trip: 从这儿到机场. Then 远 / 不远, or 要 + length of time: 要一个小时, 要十分钟. 多长时间 asks how long.

examples.py: Cóng zhèr dào jīchǎng yuǎn ma?
examples.en: Is it far from here to the airport?

examples.py: Zuò dìtiě yào duō cháng shíjiān?
examples.en: How long does the metro take?

dialogue.title: To the airport
dialogue.setting: Anna flies home tomorrow and asks Chen Yu about getting to the airport.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.py: Míngtiān wǒ zuò fēijī huí Měiguó.
lines.en: I fly back to the US tomorrow.

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.en: How are you getting to the airport?

lines.speaker: anna
lines.zh: 打车吧。从这儿到机场远吗？
lines.py: Dǎchē ba. Cóng zhèr dào jīchǎng yuǎn ma?
lines.en: By taxi, I guess. Is it far?

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.py: Hěn yuǎn, dǎchē yào yí ge xiǎoshí.
lines.en: Very. A taxi takes an hour.

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.zh: 坐地铁吧，地铁站不远，走路十分钟。
lines.py: Zuò dìtiě ba, dìtiězhàn bù yuǎn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng.
lines.en: Take the metro. The station's a ten-minute walk.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.py: Zuò dìtiě yào duō cháng shíjiān?
lines.en: How long does the metro take?

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.zh: 四十分钟。我开车送你吧！
lines.py: Sìshí fēnzhōng. Wǒ kāichē sòng nǐ ba!
lines.en: Forty minutes. Actually, I'll drive you!

lines.speaker: anna
lines.py: Zhēn de ma? Tài xièxie nǐ le!

questions.q: How long does a taxi take?
What does Chen Yu offer in the end?

reading.title: How to get to my place
reading.blurb: Lin An's directions to a friend arriving from the airport.
reading.purpose: Lin An sent you directions. Read to find out where to get off, how long it takes, and what to do when you arrive.

lines.speaker: linan
lines.zh: 从机场到我家，你坐地铁吧。
lines.py: Cóng jīchǎng dào wǒ jiā, nǐ zuò dìtiě ba.
lines.en: From the airport to my place, take the metro.

lines.speaker: linan
lines.zh: 坐地铁到大学站，要四十分钟。
lines.py: Zuò dìtiě dào Dàxué Zhàn, yào sìshí fēnzhōng.
lines.en: Ride to University station; it takes forty minutes.

lines.speaker: linan
lines.zh: 从大学站到我家不远，走路五分钟。
lines.py: Cóng Dàxué Zhàn dào wǒ jiā bù yuǎn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng.
lines.en: My place is a five-minute walk from the station.

lines.speaker: linan
lines.en: Don't take a taxi, it's too expensive!

lines.speaker: linan
lines.py: Dào le gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà!

questions.q: Where do you get off the metro?
How long is the walk from the station?
Why does Lin An say not to take a taxi?

lines.speaker: linan
lines.py: Cóng jīchǎng dào wǒ jiā, nǐ zuò dìtiě ba.
lines.en: From the airport to my place, take the metro.

lines.speaker: linan
lines.zh: 从大学站到我家不【远】，走路五【分钟】。
lines.py: Cóng Dàxué Zhàn dào wǒ jiā bù yuǎn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng.
lines.en: My place is a five-minute walk from the station.

conversation.title: Planning a trip across town
conversation.context: A friend asks how you're getting to a party.
conversation.goal: Say how you'll travel, how far, how long
conversation.aiPartnerBrief: You are 林安. Ask how the learner is travelling; use HSK 1 transport words.

natural.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the metro?

pragmatics.note: 请问 (may I ask) opens any question to a stranger.

pragmatics.situation: Thanking a friend for a big favour
pragmatics.note: 感谢您的帮助 sounds like a business email; with friends, 太谢谢你了 is warm.

tasks.statement: The speaker is taking a taxi.
tasks.why: 坐地铁 is the metro; a taxi is 打车.
一个小时 is one hour.
开车送你 is "drive you there".

prompt.en: How are you getting to the airport?

prompt.py: Cóng zhèr dào dìtiězhàn yuǎn ma?
prompt.en: Is the metro far from here?

line.en: How are you getting to the airport?

lines.zh: 我明天坐【飞机】回家。从这儿到机场很【远】，打车要一个【小时】。
lines.py: Wǒ míngtiān zuò fēijī huí jiā. Cóng zhèr dào jīchǎng hěn yuǎn, dǎchē yào yí ge xiǎoshí.
lines.en: I fly home tomorrow. The airport is far from here; a taxi takes an hour.

notes: AI-assisted draft. 送 is reused with its second meaning (to see someone off / give a lift).
